instruction: A volcanic caldera scene: a steaming crater lake ringed by black basalt cliffs, glowing lava cracks veining the rock, fumaroles venting steam plumes, obsidian boulders, a lava flow inching down one slope, gnarled dead trees, drifting ash motes, and a smoke column rising from the cone against a bruised orange sky.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Volcanic Crater Vents. A volcanic caldera scene: a steaming crater lake ringed by black basalt cliffs, glowing lava cracks veining the rock, fumaroles venting steam plumes, obsidian boulders, a lava flow inching down one slope, gnarled dead trees, drifting ash motes, and a smoke column rising from the cone against a bruised orange sky. Style: dramatic elemental. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
